scan_method: Folder/name/extension taxonomy scan over C:\Users\lubao\Documents\xiigen, then subtract registry v6 Types 1-23 and prior U01-U24 families.
note: These are additional artifact families that are still not explicit in registry v6 or the earlier uncovered document-family scan.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: configuration_schema_contracts
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Machine-readable JSON schema contracts for product/config behavior, not execution state JSON.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Add as schema-contract evidence; usable for validation/arbiter pairs after field-level extraction.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: dependency_and_build_manifests
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Build graph, package metadata, dependency pins, target frameworks, and project references.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Use as build/dependency evidence only; never as general architecture truth.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: ci_editor_and_repository_configs
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Repository automation, local workspace policy, editor behavior, and ignore/include rules.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Separate from agent tooling instructions; mostly tool-compliance or exclusion policy evidence.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: executable_utility_scripts
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Operational scripts that encode actual process order and file handling behavior.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Treat as executable process evidence; extract behavior cautiously from code paths, not comments alone.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: source_code_contract_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Live interface, DTO, enum, and runtime contract definitions outside topology/seeder code.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Add as runtime-contract authority; stronger than prose for exact DTO fields.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: model_checkpoint_and_training_artifacts
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Generated model state, checkpoint lineage, tokenizer state, and binary training outputs.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Exclude binaries from DPO text; use manifests only as training lineage or measurement evidence.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: training_dataset_row_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Already-generated learning rows, coverage ledgers, and tabular training/test datasets.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Classify as dataset artifacts; audit for provenance before reusing to avoid self-training loops.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: spreadsheets_and_decision_matrices
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Structured planning, comparison, mapping, and decision tables stored as spreadsheets.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Extract tables first; classify each sheet as decision, mapping, metric, or excluded.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: rendered_html_and_browser_captures
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Rendered pages, UI outputs, captured prompts, and static site/legal pages.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Do not treat raw HTML as text source; strip/render first and classify by origin.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: visual_binary_assets_and_theme_packages
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Images, icons, fonts, visual references, screenshots, and theme packages.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Keep out of text DPO; use only for visual QA, UI evidence, or asset provenance.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: localization_and_language_variants
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Non-English or translated variants of existing documents, distinct from migration plans.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Attach language and canonical-source metadata; avoid counting translations as independent truth.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: runtime_environment_and_deployment_templates
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Runtime wiring, deploy topology, service composition, and package installation descriptors.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Use as operational contract evidence only after secret/sensitive-field screening.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: diagram_and_topology_source_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Machine-readable diagrams, topology graphs, dependency graphs, and visual architecture source files.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Parse as graph/topology evidence; do not flatten into prose before preserving nodes and edges.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: runtime_debug_and_tool_logs
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Raw execution logs from tools, builds, local servers, package managers, and debugging sessions.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Use only as measurement/failure evidence after timestamp, command, and environment normalization.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: test_suite_source_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Executable tests and mocks that encode expected behavior more precisely than prose plans.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Treat as executable acceptance evidence; separate test intent from helper/mocking scaffolding.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: plugin_extension_manifest_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Plugin runtime permissions, entry points, UI surfaces, and extension packaging metadata.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Classify separately from package.json because manifests define runtime capability boundaries.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: office_pdf_and_exported_document_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Binary office/PDF documents whose content may duplicate or supersede markdown sources.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Render/extract first, dedupe against markdown, then classify by content type and version.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: vendored_third_party_codebases
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Extracted third-party repositories embedded in the workspace as reference material or skill sources.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Require external-source/license boundary; never mix as internal XIIGen authority without adoption record.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: generated_ui_code_outputs
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Generated UI/code artifacts produced by conversion experiments, not source-of-truth specifications.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Use as artifact examination input or BUG/UI correction evidence, not as architecture authority.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: before_after_visual_comparison_sets
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Paired visual examples showing bad vs improved UI, layout, or generated design output.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Use only with visual QA extraction; pair metadata must preserve before/after direction.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: positive_negative_example_catalogs
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Curated example banks where chosen/rejected or pass/fail examples are already authored.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: High-value DPO source, but only after checking labels, provenance, and whether examples are synthetic.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: algorithm_reference_and_math_notes
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Algorithmic and mathematical reference material that is not XIIGen architecture by itself.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: CODE_Q/reference only unless a XIIGen decision explicitly adopts the algorithm.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: localized_user_facing_guides
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Human-facing translated guides whose language variant matters for source identity.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Attach locale and original-source pointer; do not count as new authority if it is only a translation.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: template_and_boilerplate_libraries
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Reusable skeletons and templates used to generate projects, skills, flows, or UI components.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Treat as generation contract evidence; separate template placeholders from concrete chosen output.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: infrastructure_as_code_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Terraform, HCL, and infrastructure topology code that declares cloud/runtime resources.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Treat as executable infrastructure contract; extract resources, dependencies, and unsafe defaults separately.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: database_schema_and_migration_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Database schema, migration ordering, seed SQL, and persistence contract changes.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Use as storage-contract evidence; preserve migration order and never mix schema facts with runtime state.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: publish_profiles_and_credential_adjacent_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Deployment publishing metadata that can contain endpoints, credentials, or environment-specific settings.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Exclude or sanitize before classification; never use secret-bearing values as training text.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: coverage_binary_and_test_result_artifacts
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Machine-generated coverage and test result artifacts that are not readable source documents.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Convert through the owning test tool first; use aggregate metrics only after provenance is known.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: native_runtime_binary_dependencies
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Compiled libraries and executables bundled with legacy apps, tools, or package dependencies.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Exclude from text DPO; keep only file identity, version, and dependency provenance if needed.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: git_repository_internal_metadata
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Internal Git storage, commit logs, branch refs, object packs, and local repository metadata.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Do not train directly; derive history only via git commands on a selected canonical repository.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: web_server_and_hosting_config_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Host-level routing, rewrite, static file, and web server runtime configuration.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Treat as deployment/runtime contract; screen for environment-specific paths and secrets.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: lock_cache_and_partial_download_artifacts
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Generated dependency locks, cache state, and partial download artifacts.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Use lock files only for dependency provenance; exclude caches and partial downloads.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: ide_project_metadata_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: IDE/project settings that control local tooling behavior but are not product source documents.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Separate from source contracts; use only for tooling-compliance or formatting rules.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: browser_export_resource_sidecars
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Sidecar resources saved with exported browser pages: images, scripts, styles, and hashed blobs.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Keep tied to the parent HTML capture; never classify sidecars as independent documents.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: non_zip_compressed_archives
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Compressed archive containers that are not ZIP and require separate extraction tooling.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Same rule as ZIP containers: unpack, dedupe, classify contents; archive filename is not training source.

additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.name: code_owner_and_repository_governance_files
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.about: Repository governance, ownership, packaging exclusion, and local hook policy files.
additional_uncovered_or_undercovered_typ.suggested_handling: Use as process/governance evidence only; do not mix with user-facing behavioral rules.
